description: Nielsen DCR SDK hello ping on secure-dcr.imrworldwide.com/cgi-bin/cfg. Nielsen documents apid as the assigned App ID, with apn and sfcode on the same initialize table. Measurement pings on /cgi-bin/gn and secure-gl.imrworldwide.com are not contracted.

params.name: apid
params.description: It is the Nielsen-assigned App ID. Nielsen documents apid as required on SDK initialize, and the cfg hello ping carries it.
params.fix_hint: Set apid to the App ID Nielsen assigned during onboarding.

params.name: apn
params.description: It is the client-defined player or site name. Nielsen documents apn as required on initialize.
params.fix_hint: Send apn as a stable name for the player or site.

params.name: sfcode
params.description: It selects the collection environment. Nielsen documents dcr for production and dcr-cert for testing.
params.fix_hint: Send sfcode=dcr in production, or dcr-cert while Nielsen is certifying the integration.
